supersedes: PT-L4-2026-11-23-v2 (sha256 e02e2e08740767dec4720a610c112010eb78ad73ad1b223b14365489a499867d), superseded after independent review of PR #248 before any v2 data was fetched; v2 itself superseded PT-L4-2026-11-23 (sha256 d0de8ceb18cc6857ec6c4478e49b73dcfb2a458823b30ade4a3d8b73479b8566)
direction: Owner direction recorded on Sector_Ops #51 (comment 7093610553, 2026-11-23 06:42Z chat answer): no agency emails; if Wheeler and Wilson stay short, replace the short lakes with a rule written and hashed before any value is opened, selecting only on how many public held-out casts exist, never on values. Owner rule applied in v3: nothing is excluded to improve a result, and unknowns count against.
dataExaminedBeforeRegistration: No water-temperature value from any source, and no v2 data at all (v2 was never run). Known before registration: the v1 step-A census COUNTS posted on Sector_Ops #51 (comment 7094108377). The selection rule uses only counts by design.

universe.definition: Directory lakes classified region SE and lakeClass R1_run_of_river_pool or R2_flow_through_reservoir in the Lake Registry v1 classification, as committed in brains/vegetation/runtime/knowledge/fleet.json (registryGeneratedAt 2026-10-13T20:20:54Z): the registry's Southeast run-of-river and flow-through reservoirs, used here as the main-stem reservoirs of the Southeast and TVA region. 62 directory ids.
universe.sameWaterRule: Directory ids that are one water count as one candidate. A station is counted once for the water; the water's lakeId for pairing is the first id in the list.
universe.points: Engine directory points (Sources/SectorEngine/Support/LakeDirectory.swift); the model is paired at this point.
universe.geometry: Lake Registry v1 analysis polygon (public bucket sector-lake-registry, lakes/{lakeKey}/geometry.v1.analysis.geojson.gz) with the index bbox. A lake with no registry geometry is NO_GEOMETRY and is not ranked.
universe.stationReview: Off the Tennessee River, a station whose name names a river is MAIN_BODY only when that river is the river impounded by the lake's own dam (the reviewer establishes this from the dam record and the map, metadata only), and EMBAYMENT otherwise; the draft marks such rows UNCLASSIFIED for that review. On a Tennessee main-stem lake any other river is EMBAYMENT. A MAIN_BODY station must have coordinates.

exclusions.rule: A candidate is EXCLUDED (never ranked, never retained) if any of these holds. Exclusion uses metadata only.
exclusions.M0_TUNING: One of its directory ids is in the M0 calibration lake list (a required input file, possibly empty, recorded with its sha256 and content), or an M0 calibration sensor site (the research-home calibration snapshot, rows with inM0CalibrationSet) lies inside its polygon or within 10 mi of its point. The runner refuses without both inputs.
exclusions.RESOLVER_SENSOR: It has a tempSensor binding (docs/data/temp_sensors.csv; in the universe: Lake Russell (R.B. Russell)|GA and Okatibbee Lake|MS), or any USGS 00010 site of type LK lies within 10 mi of its point (the resolver's nearest-lake-gauge fallback, WaterLevelService.nearestWaterTemp), whatever that site's recent activity.
exclusions.WT_SAT_1: It is in the WT-SAT-1 lake list. While that list is unfrozen, every lake with a USGS 00010 site of type LK inside its polygon is excluded (WT-SAT-1 eligibility starts from those sensors). Once the list is committed, its lakes are excluded as well.
exclusions.note: The four frozen lakes are excluded from WT-SAT-1 by that draft; they are tested here like any other candidate under the M0 and resolver rules.

window.census: 2021-01-01 to the census cutoff (the day before step A v3 runs, recorded in the output).
window.frozenHoldout: Stage 3C.3's holdout window was 2021-01 to 2026-06. It applies only to the four frozen lakes. For them, casts after 2026-06-30 count under v3 only if the owner accepts this protocol as the Level-4 rule (publication); the census reports both windows for them so the difference is visible. The v1 census found no main-body casts after 2026-06-30 at any of the four.
window.replacementLakes: No replacement lake has been used to fit, tune or select any Water Temp model (the exclusions remove every lake with an M0 or resolver sensor), so all its casts in the census window are held out.

independence.protection: Truth values are opened only in step B, only for the selected lakes' counted casts. They may never be used afterwards to calibrate, tune or select a model; the selected lakes become protected lakes.

truthUnit.name: qualifying cast
truthUnit.definition: One local calendar date (WQP ActivityStartDate as reported) at one MAIN_BODY station with at least one counted reading. A counted reading is a whitelisted WQP Result-depth row with CharacteristicName exactly 'Temperature, water', ResultStatusIdentifier not 'Rejected', and depth <= 1.5 m, where depth is ResultDepthHeightMeasure when it parses and ActivityDepthHeightMeasure otherwise (m, ft or cm). Activity metadata is not used to count.
truthUnit.crossOrganizationDuplicates: As v1: same water and date, station coordinates within 0.002 degrees: one cast, the one with more depth records kept.
truthUnit.surfaceValue: Step B, from the counted readings only: mean of the readings at 0 to 1.0 m, else the shallowest reading <= 1.5 m. deg F converted. A reading with an unknown unit or a value outside -0.5 to 40 deg C is a step-B truth reject: counted and reported, never silently dropped.
truthUnit.depthOrder: ResultDepthHeightMeasure first, then ActivityDepthHeightMeasure; the same order in step A (counting) and step B (surface value).

stepA.metadata: WQP Station and Activity metadata per candidate bbox, stored only as whitelisted columns (identifiers, names, coordinates, dates, depths, organisation, type; no comment or measure columns). Activity metadata is kept for the record and is not used to count.

resultDepth.rule: WQP Result rows for the same query are read through a column whitelist. Only these columns are parsed and stored: OrganizationIdentifier, MonitoringLocationIdentifier, ActivityIdentifier, ActivityStartDate, CharacteristicName, ResultStatusIdentifier, ActivityDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureValue, ActivityDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureUnitCode, ResultDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureValue, ResultDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureUnitCode. Any column whose name starts with ResultMeasure (the value and its unit) and every other column is never indexed, parsed or written. The raw response is not stored; only the whitelisted rows are, and their sha256 is recorded.
resultDepth.limitation: The temperature value is present in the downloaded HTTP bytes and Python's csv module splits it into each parsed row in memory. The runner's code indexes only the whitelisted positions, so it never reads, converts, stores or prints the value, and the stored file has no value column. A test proves the value positions are never indexed.

stepA.usgsSites: USGS Water Data OGC API metadata (monitoring-locations with site type, and time-series-metadata for parameter 00010) per candidate bbox widened by 10 mi; identifiers, types and coordinates only. Stored only as whitelisted properties (monitoring_location_id, site_type_code, parameter_code, geometry).
stepA.stations: Station classes (v1 classes) from metadata. Assignment: the candidate whose polygon contains the station (100 m tolerance); for Tennessee River main-stem lakes the river mile from the station name or an ADEM TENR-nnn identifier resolves overlaps and marks the 2.0 river miles below the upstream dam as TAILWATER. A station in no polygon is OUTSIDE; in two polygons with no river mile, AMBIGUOUS. A reviewer may move UNCLASSIFIED rows only, from names and coordinates, BEFORE the census is run, with a one-line note each; the reviewed file is hashed and the census refuses a different file. The census takes the reviewed file, its sha256 as posted, and the draft; it refuses a mismatched hash, any reclassified row that was not UNCLASSIFIED in the draft, a reclassified row without a reviewNote, added or removed rows, and a MAIN_BODY row without coordinates.
stepA.census: Count qualifying casts per candidate water in the census window from the Result-depth rows only, and for the four frozen lakes also to 2026-06-30. Readings dropped for status or depth are counted and reported per water.

selection.retain: Each frozen lake that is not EXCLUDED and has >= 25 qualifying casts is retained.
selection.replace: The remaining slots (to 4 lakes) are filled from the other non-excluded candidates with >= 25 qualifying casts, ranked by qualifying casts descending, ties broken by sha256(lakeId) ascending.
selection.sufficiency: SELECTED when 4 lakes are chosen and their total is >= 150. Otherwise INSUFFICIENT_TRUTH, and the shortfall is reported; no value is opened.
selection.freeze: selection.json lists the 4 lakes, each lake's counted cast keys, the exclusion record, the reviewed station-file sha256 and the census sha256. Its sha256 is posted on Sector_Ops #51 before step B. Step B refuses any other selection. The selection also records each counted cast's counted readings (ActivityIdentifier and depth), so step B cannot add or swap readings.
selection.neverUses: Temperature values, model output, residuals or any other value.

stepB.gate: Runs only after: selection SELECTED and its sha256 posted on Sector_Ops #51; an Owner request (Michael, ...) for step B. Every step-B command takes the posted selection sha256 and the reviewed station file and refuses on any mismatch. The --owner-request check is a string check, not proof; the posted request is the control.
stepB.fetch: WQP Result rows for each counted cast only: one query per (MonitoringLocationIdentifier, ActivityStartDate) with startDateLo = startDateHi = that date. No other Result rows are fetched.
stepB.compare: As v1 (production M0, discovery.py), pairing each counted cast with M0 for its lake-local date. compare is write-once: it refuses to overwrite an existing result, and the result records the selection, forcing and result-file hashes.
stepB.forcing: Open-Meteo archive daily forcing at each selected water's point, for exactly [earliest counted cast date - 46 days, latest counted cast date] of that water, derived from the selection; the window is not a command-line choice. Full request parameters are recorded. Forcing that does not contain every day from 45 days before each counted cast to the cast is refused.

primary.perLakeRmseC: sqrt(mean((M0 - truth)^2)) over the lake's paired casts, deg C
primary.pooledEqualLakeRmseC: sqrt(mean over the 4 lakes of each lake's mean squared error), deg C

reported: per-season RMSE when a season has >= 5 casts

passMark.sufficiency: A selected lake FAILS if any counted cast is unpaired (unpaired share > 0), if its forcing is missing, or if fewer than 25 casts remain scored after step-B truth rejects. There is no INSUFFICIENT_PAIRED outcome in v3.
passMark.source: Unchanged from v1 (tools/research/discovery.json pooledRmseC 2.5, pre-declared 2026-10-23). Whether this replaces the private Stage 3C.3 pass mark is the owner's rubric decision; Stage 3C.3's rule was defined on the four frozen lakes and has no recorded form for replacement lakes.
passMark.rule: PASS only if all 4 lakes are scored (no lake failed the rules above), each lake's RMSE <= 2.5 deg C and the pooled equal-lake RMSE <= 2.5 deg C.

publication.runOutput: Local files in the water-temperature research folder only, labelled INTERNAL_EXPERIMENTAL and NOT_FOR_CUSTOMERS.
publication.report: A short summary on Sector_Ops #51: counts, exclusions, selection and its hash; metrics and outcome only if step B ran.
publication.scorer: frozen-scores.json water-temp is published verbatim. A PASS changes nothing by itself. Adopting this protocol (with replacement lakes) as the Level-4 rule is a rubric decision, and changing the score, the protectedLakes constants or the validation nodes is a separate owner-approved change.

limitations: The universe is the registry's SE R1/R2 classes; the registry classification is a research feature set, so a main-stem reservoir classed R3 or R4 is not a candidate and a tributary reservoir classed R1 or R2 is.
Casts are mostly daytime grabs and data-logger profiles; M0 is a daily value at the lake point, which may be tens of km from the station.
Replacement lakes did not exist in Stage 3C.3; their Level-4 result is comparable to the frozen four only after the owner adopts this protocol.
Off the Tennessee, the main-stem river decision for a named river rests on the reviewer reading the dam record and the map; it is made before the census and never sees a count.
changesFromV2: Unknowns count against: a selected lake FAILS if any counted cast is unpaired (no M0 value) or its forcing is missing; a lake whose scored casts drop below 25 after step-B truth rejects FAILS (never INSUFFICIENT_PAIRED).
The counted cast set is decided in step A from the whitelisted Result-depth rows alone (characteristic, status, depth with one depth order), the same rows step B reads with values.
Forcing window is derived from the frozen selection's cast dates; forcing that does not cover every counted cast is refused; compare is write-once.
Census binds to the reviewed station-file sha256 and the draft; only UNCLASSIFIED rows may be reclassified, each with a reviewNote; step B re-checks the posted selection sha256 and the station file.
The M0 calibration lake list is a required input and is recorded in the exclusions.
Station, Activity and USGS metadata are stored only as whitelisted columns/properties; redirects are re-checked against the allowlist on every hop.
The main-stem river rule for stations off the Tennessee is part of the protocol.
